description: Cancel a Strategy Lab optimization run you started. Takes effect after the current experiment finishes, not instantly -- check get_optimization_status to confirm it actually stopped. Any best version found before cancellation is kept but HELD (latestVersion is not changed); get_optimization_status then shows progress.cancelled, progress.heldVersionId and progress.heldBecause, and the author can still accept it in the TradeStaq web app.

jobId.description: Job ID to cancel, from start_optimization_run.

name: cancel_optimization_run
